claims.claim: Fixing a typo via PR requires forking, editing and creating a PR, which is heavyweight for contributors without write access
claims.quote: it’s a bit of a heavyweight operation for the person submitting the fix

claims.claim: Forks pollute the contributor's repository list unless deleted
claims.quote: The forked repository pollutes their list of repositories

claims.claim: Specifying the change in a comment shifts work to the maintainer, so it often never gets done
claims.quote: Chances are, it’s too much trouble and they don’t get around to it.

claims.claim: GitHub Suggested Changes has existed since October 2018 but is not well known
claims.quote: It’s been around since October 2018, but is still not that well-known.

claims.claim: Suggestions are made from the Files changed tab of a pull request via a plus/minus button in the line comment form
Maintainer sees suggestion as a diff and accepts with two clicks
claims.quote: Technically, it’s two clicks, but let’s not quibble over clicks.

claims.claim: Accepted suggestion creates a commit with commenter as co-committer, giving credit and avatar in file history
Maintainers can retroactively wrap a plain comment in a suggestion block to credit the commenter
Author finds suggested changes useful for markdown docs collaboration
claims.quote: I’ve found it very useful when collaborating on markdown documents

claims.claim: Post has a per-post 'suggest edit' link for typos
claims.quote: Found a typo or mistake in the post? suggest edit

claims.claim: Commenter Thomas Levesque could not see the button and objected that it only works from pull requests, not from the file itself
claims.quote: Why can’t we do it directly from the file itself?

claims.claim: Olafski: only working on existing PRs is limiting and would add changes to a PR about something else
claims.quote: only being able to do this on existing PRs would be limiting

claims.claim: Spike: UI labels 'commit suggestion' mislead; it actually commits to the source branch and triggers build checks
claims.quote: Github needs to hire a UX engineer who understands some basic principles.

claims.claim: Shelby accidentally committed to coworker's branch and could not suggest changes to a file the author had not touched
claims.quote: I could not make the change on a file that the original person had not touched

claims.claim: Angel Rosario says in 2025 the feature is still not well known in their team
claims.quote: this feature is still not well-known

analysis_rows.segment: OSS maintainers and contributors making small fixes
analysis_rows.positioning: Suggest exact change in a comment; maintainer accepts in one or two clicks; co-author credit
analysis_rows.key_facts: Around since October 2018; still not well-known (per 2019 post and 2025 comment)
Requires fork, edit, PR; fork pollutes repo list

analysis_rows.positioning: Per-post link to report typo or mistake
Source of tips by Phil Haack and Sarah Guthals

analysis_rows.symptom: Reader typo fixes via PR rarely happen
analysis_rows.cause: Fork, edit, create PR is heavy for a one-word fix

analysis_rows.symptom: Fix specified in a comment often never applied
analysis_rows.cause: Maintainer must review comment and redo change manually
analysis_rows.fix: Suggestion block accepted with a click

analysis_rows.symptom: Users cannot find or use suggested changes
analysis_rows.cause: Only available from PR Files changed tab, not from file view
analysis_rows.evidence: Comments by Thomas Levesque and Olafski

analysis_rows.symptom: Users accidentally commit instead of suggest
analysis_rows.cause: Button labeled 'commit suggestion' commits to source branch

analysis_rows.symptom: Cannot suggest changes on a file the PR author did not touch
analysis_rows.cause: Suggestions limited to files in the PR diff

analysis_rows.evidence: Angel Rosario 2025 comment about team reactions
